requirements.description: Public transport access is explicitly a priority for the user. Set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71) to favor buildings with strong metro, bus, or station access.

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The 14-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided. Public transport access and energy class are not reference columns and are not filtered.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on school properties (property_type = 'Attività scolastiche') with surface_area >= 180 and mobility >= 71, restricted to a 3.0 km radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892 via haversine_km on latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by distance from that point, ascending. Capacity (14 people) and energy class are not in the extracted requirements, so they are not applied.
